dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: Forgive my presumption, but I am confident that you will emerge victorious from the final trial — safe and sound, and having obtained the token.

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: Phew, that sure was one long wait. Not gonna lie, the longer I waited, the more anxious I became.

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: It was my idea in the first place, true, but if you went into the ruins only to never return, I'd be beside myself with guilt...

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: Though, if you'll excuse my bluntness, I must ask — surely you've found the token that the Sage of the Stolen Flame left within the ruins?

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Hah, I knew you'd do it!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look, they turned out to be these disk thingamajigs! We've already gotten our hands on both of the tokens!

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: No, surely not... two Golden Entreaties!? G—Golden Entreaties actually exist? Incredible! I must include this in my research.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So these things are called Golden Entreaties, huh...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Th—That's right. Apologies, I'm just so excited. It is said that they were once handled by the legendary Sage of the Stolen Flame, and even the first Pyro Archon...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: For a moment there, I was thinking about what it might be like to keep them for myself as family heirlooms or something of the sort...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #No way! We need them to save {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: I know, I know... Well, I suppose now you must set forth for the Great Volcano of Tollan.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Legend has it that long ago, before Xbalanque became the Pyro Archon, it was there that he fought against the Flamelord who wielded the powers of blinding light and searing heat...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: When the dust had finally settled, the triumphant hero Xbalanque returned alive to become the first Pyro Archon.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: But as for what lies within the volcano, no one knows for sure. Some believe that an ancient dragon still resides there, deep in hibernation — yet others say it is but a husk, all inside having been incinerated by Xbalanque's flames.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: If you ask me though, these are nothing but storytellers' speculations...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: I'd love to go with you, but I'm afraid that would be asking a bit too much of this poor old body of mine...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't sweat it. You've already told us plenty!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Well, I must thank the two of you once again. I can't tell you how much seeing those Golden Entreaties means to me. Speaking of which, I'd better hurry back and get all this recorded...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: #Thank you once more, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. I wish you a safe journey...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: #And {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, I wish you success removing the mark of the Flamelord's Blessing.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Farewell!

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Yes... At the journey's end, the place where all souls come to rest, we will meet again — I am sure of it!

choices.text: Tough as a piece of cake.

response.speaker: Player

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: #Huh? Forgive my asking, {NICKNAME}, but did I just hear you say "Ochkanatlan"...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Explain that you saw it when you touched the stone tablet...)

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Wow, who'd have thought it'd be in Ochkanatlan... The ruins of an ancient city that lies across a narrow stretch of water, north of the Flower-Feather Clan...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: If that's where it is, then I am truly sorry, but I cannot help you. Not only does my tribe forbid me to go there, but so does the Saurian Relics Association...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Apparently, it is said that many years ago, some Association members received a commission to investigate that place, but after setting out, they vanished without a trace.

response.speaker: Manqu

dialogues.text: Oh yeah, remember to show Manqu the token you got. He should still be waiting for us over at the entrance to the ruins...
